title.en: Show and resume the anonymous Beginner in-progress score
title.zh: 显示并恢复匿名初级课程当前分数

purpose.en: Complete the real-Chrome recovery after v25 proved exact sentence-builder phase resume: include the current answered card in the visible daily score during feedback, sentence building, and refresh while keeping the feature cookie non-sensitive and speaking opt-in.
purpose.zh: 完成 v25 已验证组句阶段准确恢复后的真实 Chrome 修复：在反馈、组句及刷新期间把当前已答卡片计入可见今日进度分，同时保持功能 Cookie 非敏感和跟读自愿开启。

en: Keep the v25 feature-scoped study, feedback, sentence-builder, and completion phase resume.
Include the current answered card in the visible anonymous daily score before sentence completion.
Restore the pending answer score and exact sentence-builder phase after refresh without requesting microphone access.
zh: 保留 v25 已实现的学习、反馈、组句与完成阶段独立恢复。
在组句完成前把当前已答卡片计入匿名今日进度分。
刷新后恢复待完成卡片的答题分和准确组句阶段，且不请求麦克风权限。

en: Anonymous Beginner Course vocabulary trial score display and its regression contract; no signed-in, payment, Clerk, database, cloud-binding, or sibling-site behavior.
zh: 匿名初级课程词汇试学分数显示及其回归合同；不影响登录态、支付、Clerk、数据库、云绑定或兄弟站点。

en: Calculate the visible score from completed-card scores plus the current non-zero answer score while the learner is on feedback, optional speaking, or sentence building.
After sentence completion, replace the pending answer with the existing weighted completed-card score so the course scoring contract remains unchanged.
Store only non-sensitive position, phase, answer points, and completed-card scores in the anonymous feature cookie.
zh: 在反馈、自愿跟读或组句阶段，以已完成卡片分数加当前非零答题分计算可见进度分。
组句完成后用既有加权卡片分替换待完成答题分，保持课程计分合同不变。
匿名功能 Cookie 只保存非敏感的位置、阶段、答题分与已完成卡片分数。

en: Run TypeScript, focused anonymous-trial contracts, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio contracts.
Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, verify the exact Project release record, and repeat the real-Chrome JA answer, Continue, refresh, phase-and-score acceptance.
zh: 执行 TypeScript、匿名试学定向合同、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合合同。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare，核对精确 Project 发布记录，并重复真实 Chrome 的日语答题、继续、刷新、阶段及分数验收。

en: Signed-in en/ja/es/it persistence remains blocked until the dedicated test learner and authenticated Gmail session are available. Acoustic normal-versus-slow timing remains unverified in a Chrome session without speech synthesis.
zh: 登录态英/日/西/意持久化仍需专用测试学员及已登录 Gmail 会话；当前 Chrome 不提供语音合成，正常/慢速声学时长仍未验证。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing anonymous feature isolation, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有匿名功能隔离、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库或云资源。
